2610.10145.title: InterView-C: A Synchronized Multimodal Corpus of VR Avatar-Mediated Survey Interviews
2610.10145.paper_summary: We present InterView-C, a German multimodal corpus of 27 survey interviews conducted entirely in virtual reality, with both interlocutors represented by avatars. The corpus aligns spoken interaction with synchronized behavioral data, including gaze, head and body movement, facial behavior, hand and finger tracking. Its reference transcripts and linguistic annotations provide a reliable interface between this multimodal spoken interaction and predominantly text-based NLP methods. This interface is important because automatically transcribing speech can distort linguistically relevant information, while downstream models trained on existing resources may additionally face transfer challenges when applied to transcribed spoken data. InterView-C therefore provides word-timed and manually post-edited verbatim transcripts for all 54 recordings, interview-item timings, questionnaire responses and negation cue and scope annotations for 1,422 sentences, 1,398 of them doubly annotated (α=0.87 for cues; α=0.81 for scopes). We demonstrate both challenges empirically: nine open-weight ASR systems disproportionately misrecognize short closed answers and number words, while negation models trained on existing corpora show lower and highly variable performance on our transcribed interviews than a model trained on the InterView-C annotations. InterView-C thus enables linguistic analyses of spoken interaction while retaining their alignment with rich multimodal behavior.
2610.10145.paper_summary_zh: 我們呈現 InterView-C，這是一個德國的多模態語料庫，包含27個完全在虛擬現實中進行的調查訪談，雙方對話者均由虛擬角色表示。該語料庫將口語互動與同步的行為數據對齊，包括視線、頭部和身體運動、面部行為、手部和手指追蹤。其參考抄本和語言註釋提供了一個可靠的接口，將這種多模態的口語互動與主要基於文本的自然語言處理方法連接起來。這個接口很重要，因為自動轉錄語音可能會扭曲語言上相關的信息，而基於現有資源訓練的下游模型在應用於轉錄的口語數據時可能還會面臨轉移挑戰。因此，InterView-C 為所有54個錄音提供了逐字時間標記和手動後編輯的抄本、訪談項目時間、問卷回應以及1,422個句子的否定提示和範圍註釋，其中1,398個句子進行了雙重註釋（提示的α=0.87；範圍的α=0.81）。我們實證展示了這兩個挑戰：九個開放權重的自動語音識別系統不成比例地誤識別短的封閉回答和數字詞，而基於現有語料庫訓練的否定模型在我們的轉錄訪談中表現出較低且高度可變的性能，與基於 InterView-C 註釋訓練的模型相比。因此，InterView-C 使得對口語互動的語言分析成為可能，同時保持其與豐富的多模態行為的對齊。
